reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:a59255b5d44d3e56d5b94e5d7dcca4da]] The chemical burn appeared when I first started using the product I guess because my body was not use to it. After my pits healed I started using again and have been good since.  I am not a medical doctor so I’m not sure if there is any long term effects but for now it works and I’m grateful. I was not paid.  Let me start by saying my armpits looked perfect before this product, no pimples or dark marks.  Now they look like they have been in a war zone

reviews.t: Works but scent is not good
reviews.x: Solid Stick is great, works just like the creams. I bought the sandlewood citrus body wash and loved that scent so buying the stick i thought would smell the same but its not. Doesn't smell like the body wash at all. But it works good so ill finish it up and try a new scent in hopes it doesnt smell like ass lol

I'm a big fan of Lume products and this did not disappoint! The scent lasts all day and I didn't smell any body odor whatsoever after 24 hours. I bought the sandalwood and citrus scent which I really enjoy. Honestly I feel like it works way better than regular deodorant and is worth the price if you need a high quality deodorant.

For 20 dollars I would expect it to work. I ordered lume before and it did not work. But I kept seeing these products and was especially interested in the new acidified body wash.  So I thought I'd give it another try. It's getting warmer now and I thought I was ready! However yesterday I showered in the morning with the body wash, completely dried off and applied the deodorant. About 6 hours later I noticed my pits stink and my clothes stink in my pits. Just got it today so I'm not sure how it will effective or not it will be yet. However, to me, it smells nothing like sandalwood or citrus. It smells like cloves or Chai. Not sure I like it but didn't want to smell floral or flowery either. On the fence with the fragrance.

Sandalwood Citrus smells like sour body odor. Not like Sandalwood at all. I don't even know if the product works because I had to wash in off shortly after applying. The smell just got even worse after being on my skin.  UPDATE: I tried the Unscented stick next. It smells like glue. It also doesn't work at all. I tried it for a week. I smelled like BO by the afternoon every day.

I've used Lume products before and have been happy! But this scent is an abomination worse than any BO your body can create on its own. I was so excited to try it: sandalwood perfumes and citrus/lemony perfumes and deodorants have worked well for me in the past so I had NO IDEA the horror that awaited me when I popped the lid on this one - REEK!! I decided to test one pit to see if maybe MAYBE it would change with my body chemistry and smell more pleasant but Ohh how wrong I was! The smell was g

I'm a woman and have always had the worst smelling pits, I smell like a bunch of onions played basketball in Arizona for 5 hours, and all the sweet lady smelling deodorants made it worse. I used to have to switch deodorant every 2 weeks to trick my pits into not smelling. This works, seriously works. I only need to put it on like every other day. I lift weights, do CrossFit and run in the heat of Georgia and I don't smell. My husband's thrilled bc it's been a joke for years how bad my pits are.

I don't know whether it's the deodorant itself, or the "biofilm" Lume states is responsible for causing clothes to stink... but I've pretty much ruined every shirt I've worn since starting to use Lume. It DID work to make ME smell better, but ruined the clothes. They sell a "biofilm buster" that supposedly helps get rid of the stink from clothes, but who wants to spray the armpit of every single shirt, scrub it, and let it sit for 30 minutes before doing a load of laundry? reviews.t: Does not live up to the hype
reviews.x: Did not last as long as the cream deodorant. Disappointed.

reviews.t: Don’t put this around your bits if you know what I mean.
reviews.x: This gave me a raging rash that lasted for WEEKS! Hydrocortisone and Benadryl barely touched it. The residue lasted even after washing so the oils or whatever in there just persisted. I felt I stunk worse and had a rash so it was pretty hellish and should be renamed Raging Rash!

I’ve used several of the cream scents and absolutely love them, controlled odor all day/every day. The sandalwood citrus is my first solid and it’s not working for me, at all. I’ll be going back to the cream.
smell is hORRIBLE.  nauseating. waste of money.

reviews.t: The best scent I’ve found with Lume!
reviews.x: This smells wonderful. It’s a deeper scent, which I enjoy. It’s like a mohogony/teakwood type scent. It doesn’t work as well as the original LUME does, but it has the texture of regular deodorant, not wet. It lasts for a day or so, when the original LUME will last me 3. Someone that doesn’t have as much oder will probably be able to use this only.  I actually use both. I start with the original then apply this for the scent. I have extremely sensitive skin and I can’t use a lot of deodorants. Na

I am so glad I finally bought this deodorant!! I was tired of jumping between “clinical strength” name brand products bc they would stop working weeks, even hours after using them. I was literally running out of deodorant options. I hesitated buying Lume, for weeks! I am so glad I tried it. I no longer smell of pits! The scent itself is nice and after awhile I no longer stink, but I’m told I smell good and clean for hours! Which is a plus! I don’t use it on other body parts, but I trust it would

I have to say that the commercials for this stuff are quite persuasive!  But as soon as I broke the seal on this deodorant, the scent itself smells like spicy armpit (I bought the sandalwood).  Have you ever showered and forgot to put on deodorant immediately after, and a few hours later you notice because your armpit isn't "dry" like it normally would be, so you do a sniff check to see if you indeed forgot deodorant, and it's starting to get a little spice to it?  That's exactly what this crap

So, I don't know if this is TMI, but I mention it in case it might help someone else. So during the summer, no matter what I do, I end up with rashes and peeling skin beneath where the underwires on my bra meet my skin. Powder helps a bit, but it's messy. I ordered this and thought, heck, let's see if it helps. DUDE. Problem eliminated. I can sweat all day and no red marks. No itching. Skin is all healed. Total game changer. And I do like the scent (though I'm more fond of woodsy scents in gener

I love sandalwood and I love citrus.  This smelled like neither.  It smelled musty with a rancid undertone.  I can’t speak to the effectiveness because minutes after I put it on I had to shower because the smell was making me queasy.  I’m very disappointed because I’d been looking forward to trying this product.  I had to return it.

I gave this two weeks and followed directions. It doesn't work. The U.S. has been experiencing a heat wave so there was no better time to test the claim of no order for 72 hours. 2 hours after using was the cutoff point. I used on a cooler day. It lasted a few hours. So, it's back to my product, Secret.

I wish the scent was a little stronger, but it controls body odor really well and doesn't leave any residue on my black clothing. My underarms are particularly sensitive and I have no issues with irritation. It also doesn't cause white heads or contribute towards ingrowns.

A friend gave me a little tube of coconut, which was smelly upon first applying but I’ll tell you what WASN’T SMELLY, my pits!!! I’m more of an earthy scent kind of girl so I bought the sandalwood stick and I’m never EVER going back to my other natural deodorant brand!!

reviews.t: Doesn't live up to the hype
reviews.x: This product only stops body odor on people who shower three times a day, work in a climate controlled environment with absolutely no stress or anxiety and eat boiled chicken, plain rice and maybe an apple.  But it smells great just before life happens.

I’ll say the same for the cream I bought, and the stick. I haven’t worn antiperspirant in many years. Finding a deodorant that works is challenging. This one passed the 70 minutes kickboxing test, and the 13 hour nursing shift test.
This is made for stinky people…. It messed with my natural Scent for a week. I hated the scent on myself but worked amazing on my stinky hubby all day long too!
This product turns my arm pits dark, the scent is mild, in less that four hours it fades away.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product works well and controls odor effectively, often better than regular deodorant.
The sandalwood citrus scent is frequently criticized, with several reviewers saying it smells bad or nothing like sandalwood or citrus.
Some reviewers report the solid stick does not work as well as the cream deodorant.
A few reviewers experienced skin irritation or other negative effects, including chemical burns, a rash, and ruined clothes.
Some reviewers find the product ineffective for them despite the hype.
